newsitem.title: USA: Internet sees Q4, year net loss.
newsitem.headline: Internet sees Q4, year net loss.

text.p: Internet Communications Corp said Wednesday that it expects to report a net loss for the fourth quarter and year ending January 31, 1997.

Additionally, the company said investors "should not expect better than break even results for fiscal 1998" because it will use profitability from its Colorado operations to fuel its expansion efforts.
The company's shares closed Wednesday off 1/2 at 4-1/8.

The company said revenues for the quarter should be about $9.8 million, compared with $4.1 million a year ago and said net sales for the year will be about $28 million, compared with $18.5 million in fiscal 1996.

"The fourth quarter is typically our weakest. In addition, during the quarter we invested a lot of effort in the integration process resulting from the merger with Interwest Communications which further impacted the bottom line," the company said in a release.

Internet Communications is a regional network integration firm that plans, designs, implements and maintains customized wide-area and local-area networks for voice and data. It also provides enhanced network services, full service Internet access, World Wide Web services and outsourcing capabilities.
